Chapter 678 - 678 Becoming Stronger; Ways To Stop It!

Chapter 678 - 678 Becoming Stronger; Ways to Stop It!

678 Becoming Stronger; Ways to Stop It!

Lin Fan sat in the courtyard and started to think about how he should improve.

The five elements of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth had all reached the perfect level.

The five elements alone already possessed extraordinary power.

If the five elements combined, how strong would that be?

Thinking up to this point, Lin Fan secretly circulated the power of the five elements.

The five elements were five completely different forces. They complemented and countered each other, repelling each other.

How difficult would it be to merge them into one?

When the five types of energy combined, they suddenly twisted and expanded violently.

A terrifying explosion instantly occurred.

The entire ground shook.

Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Hu Tian, Song Jiaxin, and the others hurriedly ran over, their faces full of worry.

Lin Fan said, “I’m researching something. Don’t worry, it’s fine.”

Hearing this, everyone heaved a sigh of relief.

And so, Lin Fan started his research again.

After that, similar explosions occurred frequently.

At first, everyone was very worried.

However, seeing that Lin Fan was safe and sound, they slowly relaxed.

…

A month passed in the blink of an eye.

Metal, wood, water, fire, and earth still showed no signs of fusing.

Lin Fan suddenly had a thought. Maybe he had not injected enough energy.

Hence, Lin Fan increased the amount of five-element power he poured in, forming a huge five-colored energy ball in the air.

This five-colored energy ball kept twisting and shaking.

Just as Lin Fan thought that there was a chance of fusing…

It suddenly exploded!

This explosion caused the earth to tremble and the mountains to shake. A strong wind howled and dust filled the air.

If not for Lin Fan’s timely release of the spatial seal, the area within a few dozen miles might have been razed to the ground.

He had failed again!

However, Lin Fan was not depressed.

That was because, at the moment of the explosion, he vaguely felt the opportunity to merge the five elements into one.

Hence, Lin Fan hurriedly gathered the power of the five elements and fused them together.

Soon, another five-colored energy ball appeared in the sky.

The next moment, the five-colored energy ball suddenly exploded, bursting out an even more terrifying storm.

Lin Fan had been staring at the five-colored energy ball the entire time.

The moment the explosion appeared, the five types of energy finally fused together. It was a perfect fusion!

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up and he said excitedly, “I see!”

Then, he shot out the five-element energy again and instantly completed the compression and fusion!

Lin Fan looked at the energy ball in his hand and said happily, “It’s a success!”

Then, he mobilized all the five elements in his body and quickly fused them together.

His strength increased greatly!

At this moment, Lin Fan had a very real feeling that his current strength was more than twice as strong as before the five elements fused into one!

He took a step forward.

In the next moment, Lin Fan appeared in front of the door.

At this moment, there were more cracks on the door than when he first saw it. There were even faint signs of chaotic squalls about to shoot in through the cracks.

Lin Fan could feel the pressure coming from the door. Then, he used his hand to caress the door gently.

At this moment, another loud sound came from the door, and more cracks appeared.

Lin Fan judged in his heart. The current him… was probably still inferior to the experts behind the door.

In addition, even if he could really defeat the experts behind the door, how could he resist the chaotic astral winds invading the world when the door shattered?

Frowning slightly, he turned around and returned to Jiangbei.

…

Just as Lin Fan was leaving, a gigantic monster that was the size of the moon was floating in the primordial chaos outside the door.

“What good luck!” It grinned. “I actually found a perfect world!

“Soon! As long as I work harder, I’ll be able to break this seal. At that time, this world will be mine!

“It must taste good! My strength will increase greatly very soon!

“Maybe I can enter the second rank!”

After a burst of maniacal laughter, it gathered its strength and once again slammed its steel-like head against the door.

A loud sound rippled, and energy scattered.

…

Even though Lin Fan knew that the entire world was in an extremely dangerous state, he still chose to live, eat, and relax with his family.

This was because cultivation was not something that could be accomplished overnight.

Not to mention, Lin Fan did not have any better methods to raise his strength right now, nor did he have any way to resolve the cracks in the Wall of the World and the door.

Today, Lin Xiaoyao, Hu Tian, Song Jiaxin, Huang Ling, and Lin Fan’s family and loved ones had set up a grill on the wide lawn.

A cloud of smoke rose, and in a short while, fragrant skewers were out of the grill.

“Yes! They smell so good!”

“As expected, kebabs are still the best!”

“Add more chillies. Hehe, it’s delicious!”

“Ah, it’s burnt.”

…

Even though there were many delicacies in the world today, they still couldn’t forget about kebabs.

Everyone ate the kebabs and chatted casually. They were very satisfied and happy.

In the blink of an eye, two weeks had passed.

On this day, the wind howled and dark clouds covered the sky.

Huang Ling, Qiu Ziqian, Su Ningjing, and the others hurriedly ran into the villa.

At this moment, a rock flew over and smashed into the glass.

A hole immediately appeared in the glass, and the surrounding area cracked continuously.

“Damn, the glass is broken!” Hu Tian said. “It’s going to rain soon. There’s no time to change the glass now. We have to quickly block it with something and get someone to change the glass tomorrow.”

“Alright!” Lin Xiaoyao replied.

Then, the two of them quickly got busy.

Lin Fan, who was sitting in the living room, did not move.

Hu Tian’s words kept echoing in his mind.

There was no time left. They had to change the glass…

The next moment, Lin Fan stood up abruptly and hugged Hu Tian. He gave her a big kiss and said excitedly, “Hu Tian, you’re amazing!”

Lin Xiaoyao blushed and said, “Brother, I’m still beside you!”

Lin Fan acted as if he did not hear her and laughed heartily. “Hahaha! I know what to do now!”

Yes!

He knew how to stop the destruction of the world!

Since the destruction of the door would destroy the world, it would be fine as long as the door remained intact or returned to its original state!

Time!

As long as the door was still intact, the world would not be affected at all!

Right now, his Time Control Technique was only at the beginner level, and he could stop time.

According to Lin Fan’s guess, as long as he reached the advanced level, he would be able to turn back time!

At that time, all the dangers would be resolved!
